x: Another baker named Savage, who had been the world's professional champion and whose records made under the name of " Billy Franks " in 1882 still stand, thereupon became interested in Harry and, having a son in the Belgraves, he got Harry introduced to our club.
Placings and times of our runners were as under:—Popplewell 42.16; Chantler 43.2; Saville 43.57; Jordan 44.21; Savage 46.23; Jefferson 46.44; Laing 46.55; Fox 47.5; Taylor A.

Positions and times of our runners were:—2, Bedford, 30.20; 3, Walker, 30.35; Poole, 30.56; 6, Bishop, A., 31.35; 8, England, 32.8; 13, Woodhead, 32.45; 15, Lacey, J., 32.49; 16, Saville, 33.6; 17, Cuff, 33.13; 24, Laing, 34.40; 26, Savage, 34.42; 28, Taylor, A.
The food and drinks were catered for by the ladies of the Club, Mesdames: Carter, Shepherd, Savage, Penny and Morrell, while their better halves thoroughly enjoyed themselves entertaining the "kids".

If he could win, and Savage(L.A.C.) and the T.V.H. man were no better than 5th or 6th, then we could win. Ted put in a fine throw to eventually take second place but the other two were fairly well placed.

Another baker named Savage, who had been the World's professional champion and whose records made under the name of "Billy Franks" in 1882 still stand, thereupon became interested in Harry and, having a son in Belgrave, he introduced Harry to our club.
